$schema: Session state manifest v3 - vertical phase slices, programmatic updates only
description: Define canonical shape for scene objects — Unity-style 2D editor with transforms, z-index, and exportable static sites

open_questions: Migration path from current scene.json to new format (planning concern)
key_decisions: Unity editor UX, not Unity ECS architecture — inspector ergonomics matter, not entity-component-system
Manifest-based component contract — components/effects declare editable properties via manifest.json, editor reads these dynamically
Open-source extensibility is a first-class concern — drop-in CSS/JS + manifest should just work
Universal base + attachable components — every scene object has a transform, behavior differs by attached components
Events are simple trigger→action pairs, not visual scripting — keep it lightweight for static landing pages
Scope is small: 2-3 pages per site, stylish static landing pages
Export is a fully bundled copy — scene.json + renderer + assets in a standalone folder, no compilation to HTML/CSS
General parent-child nesting supported — objects can be grouped arbitrarily, not just glyph-group children
Child transforms relative to parent — moving a group moves its children
Percentage-based positioning — everything scales responsively to viewport size
Single-viewport, no-scroll game-menu pages — everything fits on one screen
Sizing as percentage of parent — width primary, height auto or explicit %. Fill mode for backgrounds/effects
Z-order is array position with drag-and-drop reordering — no explicit z-index numbers
SVG sub-layers are baked — only author-exposed 'slots' appear in the editor, not 40+ children
Manifest declares only component-specific properties — visible/enabled is a universal object toggle, not a manifest concern
Project-level hierarchy — a project contains multiple scenes (pages), export bundles all of them
Project manifest is thin — appearance lives on scenes or objects, not the project

commits.message: checkpoint-2: Renderer consumes canonical SceneObject shape
